chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the lark, the sparrow, and the wren, the one in Ihram kills them. He (peace be upon him) said: Upon him is a Mudd of food for each one of them.

key_terms.الصَّعْوَةِ: The wren (a type of small bird)
key_terms.الْقُبَّرَةِ: The lark (a type of small bird)
key_terms.مُدٌّ: A Mudd, a traditional unit of volume/measure for food
key_terms.يَقْتُلُهُمُ الْمُحْرِمُ: The one in Ihram kills them

ai.seo_question: What is the expiation for killing birds while in Ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi specifies the kaffarah (expiation) for killing small birds like the lark, sparrow, and wren while in Ihram, establishing a fixed compensation of one Mudd of food per bird. It reflects the Shia juristic tradition of applying proportional restitution based on the type of creature, distinguishing these small birds from larger game in terms of ritual penalty.
